messages.subject: Preferential sampling
parts:
Dear INLA users,

I would like to fit a preferential sampling model and I am following the example on chapter 4 of the book "Advanced Spatial Modeling with SPDE using R-INLA".

In order to include the LGRF in the likelihoods of the point process and of the response predictor, the copy effect has to be used and, in the book, a gaussian prior for this (scale) parameter is assigned. 

My question is what is the default prior for this parameter?

Thank you in advance,
Lídia
